days.label: Friday
days.text: Friday starts on College Street, where a Burlington native opens Shakurs Vintage , a Y2K and vintage shop on the second floor of 209 College that also carries pieces from a few Burlington Vintage Market regulars. At 2, UVM athletic director Jeff Schulman talks about the challenges and opportunities facing UVM Athletics at the EEE lecture series at Faith United Methodist Church in South Burlington, and UVM's Humanities Center opens a free conference on Religion and the American Founding at the Alumni House, with registration required. Runners can meet at Burlington Beer Co. at 5:50 for the Green Mountain Athletic Association's monthly beer and social run , with a route preview before heading out at 6 and two route options for shorter and longer distances.

days.label: Friday
days.text: Friday night fills up fast. New York comic David Drake starts at 6:30 at the Vermont Comedy Club, with two more shows Saturday. At 7, Déjà Rêvé Actors Guild opens David Ives' 'Venus in Fur' at Off Center for the Dramatic Arts, about an actress who shows up unannounced to audition for a first time director (also Saturday at 7 and Sunday at 2). Also at 7, 686 hosts the free Burlington premiere of the ski film Aim For The Bushes at Karma Bird House with the crew and director there, Foundry Collective launches Unframed , a new underground hip hop series with Mavstar, MC Humble and DJ Kanganade, at the Venetian by donation, and dads can drop in for ping pong night at Dad Guild's Guild Hall in the Soda Plant. Austin rockers White Denim bring their thirteenth album to the Higher Ground Showcase Lounge at 7:30 with Arc Iris opening, and the Mad Robin contra dance gets going at 8 at First Congregational Church, with a beginners' lesson at 7:40 and no partner needed. At 8, Shelburne Vineyard hosts four comics for Wit & Wine Comedy Night , rock band B-Town plays free at The Old Post, and the Monkey House in Winooski has the October edition of Untapped drag and burlesque show (21+, $15 at the door). Benjamin Tod of Lost Dog Street Band plays Higher Ground at 8:30 with Candi Jenkins opening, and tickets from Thursday's show, which was canceled for illness, are good tonight. Night owls can catch DJ Taka at Standing Stone in Winooski at 11.

days.label: Saturday
days.text: Saturday is the sunny one, and we're spending it outside. BTown Coffee Club [MEETUP] is at Zero Gravity at 10, then at 11 we head to Shelburne Orchards for Apple Picking + Cider Donuts [MEETUP] , meeting near the orchard store before we go pick. At 1, Pub Crawl II [MEETUP] starts at Switchback and works its way to Burlington Beer Co. and Citizen Cider, so join for one stop or the whole crawl. Make a Saturday of all three, we'd love to see you!

days.label: Sunday
days.text: Sunday starts early for dads, with Dad Guild's Run Club heading out from Staniford Road on a casual 3.5 mile bike path run at 7:30. The Winooski Farmers Market runs 10 to 2 with more than 25 vendors, and from 11 to 2 Passion 4 Paws brings adoptable dogs and their fosters to Heritage Toyota on Shelburne Road for its fall adoption event , with adoption fees cut to $295 for dogs at the event. Switchback has football on the big screen from noon with house smoked BBQ, and Foam hosts Matt Hagen's Sinister Sunday Songs at 1. Four Quarters in Winooski throws a free, all ages Fall Harvest Fest from 1 to 6 with local artists, producers, food and kids' activities, and the Neon Ramblers play from 4 to 6. Shelburne's Hi, Neighbor gathering runs 2 to 4 at the Bay Ridge community playground, with a light snack and bubbles for kids, and at 3 Rusty DeWees hosts a book party at the St. John's Club for the 43rd anniversary edition of Real Vermonters Don't Milk Goats, with trivia and nibbles. The Venetian's Karaoke Night starts at 6, Goose drummer Cotter Ellis brings Cotter & Friends to Foam for a free night of jam, rock and jazz at 7, and musical comedian Stephen Lynch closes out the weekend at Higher Ground with a seated 18+ show, doors at 7.
